narrative.intro: Barnard Construction has $5.9B in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Barnard Construction has 12 awards this fiscal year with an average award size of $490M, and obligations are up 2967.6% year over year. Barnard Construction received the largest share of FY2026 obligations from the Department of Homeland Security, which obligated $4.5B, followed by the Department of Defense with $1.3B. Barnard Construction’s work is concentrated in construction markets. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $4.5B of obligations, and Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction accounts for $1.3B. Smaller-dollar activity appears in Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction at $500K. Historical fiscal-year obligations show lower activity before FY2026, including $5.2M in FY21, $132M in FY22, $4.1M in FY23, $33.4M in FY24, and $192M in FY25. This profile shows a large, concentrated FY2026 increase in government construction obligations for Barnard Construction.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Barnard Construction's FY2026 obligations?
sections.body: Barnard Construction has $5.9B in FY2026 obligations concentrated in a few large awards, given the average award size of $490M and a total award count of 12. Barnard Construction shows most obligation value in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at $4.5B and in Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction at $1.3B.

sections.heading: Who are Barnard Construction's top buyers and what markets do they fund?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security is the top buyer, obligating $4.5B to Barnard Construction in FY2026 to date, followed by the Department of Defense at $1.3B. The Department of Agriculture appears with smaller activity at $500K, which aligns with smaller-dollar NAICS categories such as Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction at $500K.

faq.q: How much does Barnard Construction make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Barnard Construction has received $5.9B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Barnard Construction has 12 awards this fiscal year and an average award size of $490M, and obligations are up 2967.6% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Barnard Construction?
faq.a: The Department of Homeland Security and the Department of Defense are the top buyers for Barnard Construction in FY2026 to date. The Department of Homeland Security obligated $4.5B and the Department of Defense obligated $1.3B; the Department of Agriculture obligated $500K.

faq.q: What does Barnard Construction sell to the government?
faq.a: Barnard Construction sells construction services to the government, concentrated in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction and Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $4.5B and Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction accounts for $1.3B in FY2026 to date.
